“Specify the type of entity that is bein: "Tlhomamisa mofuta wa selo se se tlhalosiwang mo rekoding eno ya maatla." (ISAAR 5.1.1) Tlhopha Corporate body, Family kgotsa Person go tswa mo menyu e e wetsang.
“Record the standardized form of name fo: "Kwala sebopego se se siametsweng sa leina la selo se se tlhalosiwang go ya ka melao kgotsa ditshwanelo tsa naga kgotsa tsa lefatshe tse di dirisiwang ke setheo se se bopileng rekoding ya maatla. Dirisa dingwaga, lefelo, molaotheo, tiro, leina la go kgaoganya le ditlhomamo tse dingwe jaaka go tlhokegang go kgaoganya sebopego se se amogelwang sa leina le tsa dilo tse dingwe tse di nang le maina a a tshwanang." (ISAAR 5.1.2)
“Purpose: To indicate the various forms: "Maikaelelo: Go supa mefuta e e farologaneng ya sebopego sa leina se se amogelwang mo dipalong tse dingwe kgotsa mefuteng ya go kwala. Molao: kwala mefuta e e bapileng ya leina go ya ka melao kgotsa ditshwanelo tsa naga kgotsa tsa lefatshe tse di dirisiwang ke setheo se se bopileng rekoding ya maatla, go akaretsa dikarolo tse di tlhokegang le/kgotsa ditlhomamo tse di tlhokegang ke melao eo." (ISAAR 5.1.3)
“Record the standardized form of name fo: "Tlhalosa sebopeo se tlwaelegileng sa leina la setlhogo se tlhalosiwang go ya ka melao kgotsa ditaelo tse dingwe. Supa melao le/goba fa go siame, leina la khampani e e dirisitsweng go aga disebopeo tse di tlwaelegileng tsa maina." (ISAAR 5.1.4)
The purpose of this field is to “indicat: Maikaelelo a lebala le ke go "supa leina le lengwe le lengwe la setlhogo sa khampani, motho kgotsa lapa se se sa dirisiwang mo Lefelong la Boitseanape. Dikao ke di-acronym, maina a a neng a le teng pele, maina a a ikgethilweng, maina a bosigo le ditlhopha tsa boitshupo kgotsa botlhale. (ISAAR 5.1.5)
“Record where possible any official numb: "Tlhalosa fa go ka kgonega nomoro ya ofisi kgotsa se sengwe se se supang (sekai, nomoro ya go ikwadisa ga khampani) ya setlhogo sa khampani mme o bue ka molao le mokgwa oo e ntshitsweng mo go one." (ISAAR 5.1.6)
“Record the dates of existence of the en: "Tlhalosa dikgato tsa botshelo jwa setlhogo se tlhalosiwang. Fa go buiwa ka dikhampani, akaretsa letsatsi la go thoma/go thegiwa/molao o o letlelelang le go fela. Fa go buiwa ka batho, akaretsa dikgato tsa matsatsi a mashi le a lefelo kgotsa, fa dikgato tseo di sa itsege, dikgato tsa floruit. Fa go dirisiwa mekgwa e e farologaneng ya go supa nako, go ka tlhalosiwa dipalo tse di lekanang go ya ka melao e e amegang. Supa mo karolong ya Melao le/goba ditaelo (5.4.3) mokgwa o o dirisitsweng wa go supa nako, sekai, ISO 8601." (ISAAR 5.2.1)
“Record in narrative form or as a chrono: "Tlhalosa ka mokgwa wa kgotsi kgotsa jaaka kronoloji ditiragalo tsa botshelo, ditiro, ditlhopho le/goba dikarolo tsa setlhogo se tlhalosiwang. Se se ka akaretsa tshedimosetso ka bong, naga, lapa le dikamano tsa boitshupo kgotsa politiki. Fa go ka kgonega, neela dikgato jaaka karolo ya tlhaloso ya kgotsi." (ISAAR 5.2.2)
“Purpose: to indicate the predominant pl: "Maikaelelo: go supa mafelo a magolo le/goba melao e setlhogo sa khampani, motho kgotsa lapa se ne se le teng, se ne se phela kgotsa se na le kamano e nngwe. Taelo: tlhalosa maina a mafelo a magolo/melao, mmogo le mofuta le dikgato tsa kamano le setlhogo." (ISAAR 5.2.3)
“Record the legal status and where appro: "Tlhalosa maemo a molao le fa go siame mofuta wa setlhogo sa khampani mmogo le dikgato tsa nako eo maemo a ne a dirisiwa ka teng." (ISAAR 5.2.4)
“Record the functions, occupations and a: "Tlhalosa ditiro, mekgwagare le ditiro tse di dirilweng ke setlhogo se tlhalosiwang, mmogo le dikgato tsa nako fa go siame. Fa go tlhokega, tlhalosa mofuta wa tiro, mekgwagare kgotsa tiro." (ISAAR 5.2.5)

Every capability with its status: releas: Tlhomamo nngwe le nngwe ka maemo a yona: e ntshitswe, go bonala pele kgotsa e akarediwa, nngwe le nngwe e na le kgokagano ya bopaki. Ke bokhutlo jwa thuto.
Everything here is sample data. Change,: Sengwe le sengwe mo go se ke data ya sekai. Fetola, oketsa kgotsa tlosa sepe se o ratang.
Exhibitions can be published as 3D space: Ditshwantsho di ka ntshiwa jaaka mafelo a 3D a mongwe le mongwe a ka tsamaya mo go one mo browser. Simolola tsela e e laolelwang mme o e letlele go go isa mo kamoreng.
Museum objects can carry 3D models. Rota: Didirisiwa tsa museamo di ka jara dimodelo tsa 3D. Potolosa, atametsa mme o tsene mo skrining e e feletseng. Tlhaloso e boloka laesense le molao wa tumalano ya model.
Open an archival description: Bula tlhaloso ya setoko sa ditshwantsho
Open the sign-in menu at the top of the: Bula menu ya go tsena kwa godimo ga leqephe mme o dirise login ya demo e e bontshiwa mo go yona. E na le ditokelo tse di feletseng, ka jalo o ka leka sengwe le sengwe. Diphetofo tsotlhe di tloswa bosigo bongwe le bongwe.
Please do not enter real personal inform: Ke kopa o se tsene tlhaiso-lesêphe ya motho e nnete.
See what else it does: Bona gore e dira eng gape
Take the guided tour of the live demo: Tsaya thuto e e laolelwang ya demo e e phelang
The demo login in the sign-in menu has f: Tsamaiso ya go tsena ya setshwantsho mo menyu ya go tsena e na le ditshwanelo tsa molaodi ka botlalo, ka jalo o ka leka tiriso nngwe le nngwe.
The tour takes you through the demo one: Leeto le go isa mo setshwantshong se le lekgatla ka nako. Mo lekgatleng lengwe le lengwe karete e nnye e bolela gore o lebelele eng le gore o leke eng, ka ditlhopha tsa go boela morago, ya pele kgotsa emisa.
The whole site is reset every night at 0: Lefelo lotlhe le busetswa mo bosigong ka 02:20 nako ya Aforika Borwa, ka jalo sepe se o se dirang fa ga se tshele, mme motho yo mongwe ga a se bone morago ga go busetsa.
Try Heratio the way an archivist would,: Leka Heratio jaaka moarchivist a ka e leka, mo metsoteng e leshome le borobabobedi.
You have left the tour page. Go back to: O tlogile lekgatla la leeto. Boela kwa o neng o le teng, kgotsa fetsa leeto.
A visit counts once a page has been open: Etelo e balwa gongwe fa lekgatla le bulegile mo browser ya nnete metsotswana e tlhano, ka jalo ba batlisisi ba tlogelwa. Aterese ya IP, cookie kgotsa dintlha tsa motho ga di bolokwe.
Choose one (optional): Kgetha e le nngwe (e sa tlhokegang)
Deploying Heratio at my institution: Go baya Heratio mo sethephalong sa me
Hosting by The Archive and Heritage Grou: Go tshegediwa ke The Archive and Heritage Group
Moving from AtoM or another system: Go fudugela go tswa AtoM kgotsa tsamaiso e nngwe
Sources: github, search, social, referra: Ditswedi: github, batlo, social, referral:<site>, campaign:<name> (go tswa mo utm_source tag mo kgokaganong), direct (ga go na lefelo la go romela).
Where demo-site visitors come from, and: Kwa ba etelang lefelo la setshwantsho ba tswang teng, le gore ba fitlha kae.
Heratio is open-source GLAM and archival: Heratio ke software ya tsamaiso ya GLAM le diarchive e bulegileng. Tlhalosa, boloka le go phatlalatsa dikgobokanyo tsa diarchive, dimyuziamo, dibalaori le dipitiso mo tsamaisong e le nngwe. Mahala ka laisense ya GNU AGPL-3.0.
